source.title: Bitcoin Falls to Its Lowest Since August While Stocks Rally and Nvidia Sinks | News Block
source.description:
Stocks closed sharply higher today, but Nvidia fell more than 4 percent as its board investigates CEO Jensen Huang's ties to a suspected Chinese spy, and Bitcoin hit its lowest level since August.

In this episode of the News Block, powered exclusively by Ledn:

• Stocks rebounded after Wall Street's worst day since April 2025
• Bitcoin hits its lowest level since August
• The Nvidia spy scandal: U.S. intelligence knew a year ago, so why did it leak now?
• The battle over whether America sells AI chips to China
• How North Korea spent five months inside Binance before the $6.3 billion theft
•

We now know a lot more about how the $6.3 billion Bynance hack happened, and it actually started five months before any money moved.
Binance says that back in June, one of its engineers downloaded software that had been tampered with.
Binance caught it and swapped out his computer, but the hackers now knew who his coworkers were.
So in September, they went after another engineer with a fake job offer.
There were interviews and then a coding test, and the test had malware hidden inside.
That gave them a foothold into Binance's systems.

In October, they used one of Binance's own internal AI tools to spread the bugs to two more employees' computers, and on one of them, they found a login that let them push code into Binance's infrastructure.
